summary: Pradeep P. Gokhale works in philosophy, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He earned his Ph.D. at Savitribai Phule Pune University in 1980, where he later served as an adjunct professor in 2018.
Pragati Sahni specializes in Buddhist studies and philosophy. A former student of Damien Keown, she served as an associate professor at the University of Delhi (attested 2026).

Praggnaparamita Biswas works in Indology. She completed her Ph.D. under Ratna Basu at Banaras Hindu University (2008–2013) and held positions at Ranaghat College (2013–2014), The Asiatic Society (2017–2021), and Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Open University (2021–2022).

Pragya Jain specializes in Indology and philosophy, earning a PhD from Mohanlal Sukhadia University in 2021. Her academic appointments include assistant professor at M. K. Sanghvi College (2011–2018) and visiting fellow at the Oxford Centre for Hindu Studies (2025).

Prahlad Pradhan was an Indologist and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Patna University and Visva-Bharati University (~1937–1944). He served as a professor at Utkal University (~1960–1974) and as principal of Gangadhar Meher University.

Pramod Chandra (1930–2016) was an art historian and Indologist who earned his PhD from the University of Mumbai (1964). He served as a professor at the University of Chicago (1971–1980) and Harvard University (1980–2004).

Pranabesh Bhattacharya is an Indologist and philosopher who earned his Ph.D. from Bankura University in 2025. He was appointed assistant professor at Sri Sathya Sai University for Human Excellence in 2025.

Pranshu Samdarshi works in Buddhist studies, Indology, and history and archaeology. After earning an M.Phil. at the University of Delhi (2010–2018), he held assistant professor posts at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham (2019–2021) and Nava Nalanda Mahavihara (2021).

Prasanna Venkatesh T S works in computational fields and Indology. He has held positions as a Ph.D. research scholar at Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda College and at the International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad.
Prasarn Lao-areun is a scholar of philosophy and Indology. He studied under Viroj Inthanon and earned a PhD from the University of Mysore (attested 2014).

Prashant Dharmadhikari specializes in Indology. He held a post at K.G. Joshi College of Arts and N.G. Bedekar College of Commerce and became an assistant professor at the Central University of Gujarat in 2023.

Pratap Chandra Chunder (1919–2008) was a scholar in history, archaeology, and Indology. He was educated at Hindu School, Presidency University (~1934–1938), and the University of Calcutta (~1938–1942), where he studied under Prabodh Chandra Bagchi.

Pratapaditya Pal is an art historian specializing in Indology and Tibetology. After earning PhDs from the University of Calcutta and the University of Cambridge, he held curatorial roles at the Museum of Fine Arts, Boston, and the Los Angeles County Museum of Art.

Praveen Verma is an Indologist who earned his Ph.D. from Jawaharlal Nehru University (1991–1997). He joined the National Institute of Plant Genome Research in 1998 and served as adjunct faculty at Jawaharlal Nehru University in 2020.
Prayag Raj Sharma is an Indologist and historian. He served as dean at the Centre for Nepal and Asian Studies (attested 1973) and as a professor at Tribhuvan University (attested 1976–1990).
Prayoon Mererk is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy. He completed his doctoral thesis at the University of Delhi in 1985 under the supervision of Margaret Chatterjee and Mahesh Tiwary.

id: P:Prince Peter of Greece and Denmark
summary: Prince Peter of Greece and Denmark (1908–1980) was a scholar of Tibetology, history, and archaeology. He earned a Dr.juris from the University of Paris, studied under Bronisław Malinowski, and completed a Ph.D. at the London School of Economics.

Pritam Saha works in philosophy, Sinology, and Indology. He earned a Ph.D. in Chinese philosophy from East China Normal University in 2025 and became a postdoctoral fellow at Sun Yat-sen University the same year.

Priyanka Basu works in Indology. After earning a B.A. from Bethune College (2003–2006), she worked as a curator at the British Library (2016–2021) and was appointed lecturer in performing arts at King's College London in 2021.

Priyanka Pradeep Salekar works in Indology, linguistics, and computational fields. She completed an M.A. at Deccan College (2017–2019) and became a PhD researcher and teaching assistant at the Indian Institute of Technology Bombay in 2021.
